quests.question: Convert to reported speech: She asked, 'Have you finished the report?'
options: She asked whether have I finished the report.
She asked whether I have finished the report.
She asked whether I had finished the report.
quests.correctAnswer: She asked whether I had finished the report.
quests.sentence: She asked, 'Have you finished the report?'
quests.hint: Yes/No questions can use 'whether', and the tense shifts too.
quests.explanation: 'Whether' introduces the question, 'have' moves after the subject, and 'have finished' shifts to 'had finished'.
